title: Scalar section localization normalization
statement:
theorem section_scalar_normalization (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : ScalarSectionData a T) (hc : ScalarSectionNormalized a T c)
    (P : CochainComplex (Modules Λ T) ℤ) :
    c.derived.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
      c.model.T.map (sectionLocalizationComparison Λ T P).hom ≫
      c.model.ε.app (((equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
    (derivedFunctor Λ' T).map (compute a T P) ≫
      (sectionLocalizationComparison Λ' T
        (((extension a T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).hom ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex c.ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4; scalar and total tensor comparisons in the proof of pullback compatibility.

proof.text: Unpack the all-complex equation in ScalarSectionNormalized. Expand the mapHomologicalComplex comparison isomorphisms. The identity comparison is the identity map of complexes; use localization functoriality on identities and remove the final identity. The remaining termwise comparison is exactly NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex of the specified ordinary comparison.

Private formulas used by the parent record elementary categorical pasting, tensor-map naturality, section resolving membership under the fixed tensor comparison, and K-flat scalar computation. These retain abstract maps instead of expanding the tensor constructions. The total scalar map is invertible because prolongation of the fixed ordinary strong monoidal scalar extension is strong monoidal.
